AVP/KYC OPERATIONS & COMPLIANCE LEAD – KYC | AML | CLIENT ONBOARDING
PROFILE SNAPSHOT
Dynamic investment banking operations lead with 14+ years of experience in driving KYC, AML and Client onboarding operations across global financial hubs. Proven expertise in New Client Onboarding, Renewals, PEP reviews, Regulatory remediation and audit readiness for APAC, UK and Frankfurt markets. Recognized as a trusted SME for complex risk assessments and regulatory audits (FCA and MAS), ensuring zero compliance breaches while optimizing onboarding efficiency. Adept at leading multi-location teams and vendor-managed operations, building scalable delivery models, and executing high-volume remediation programs under tight regulatory timelines. Accomplished in shaping policy, embedding change management, and delivering operational resilience that consistently meets global compliance standards and business expectations.
CORE SKILLS & COMPTENCIES
Client Onboarding & KYC Remediation | Regulatory Audit Readiness (FCA, MAS, MiFID) | AML/KYC Compliance & Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) | PEP Reviews & Source of Wealth Assessments | Quality Control (4-Eye/6-Eye Frameworks) | Regulatory Reporting & Audit Closure | Operational Resilience & Governance | Risk Calibration & Policy Interpretation | MIS, KPI Dashboards & Performance Tracking | Process Improvement & Root-Cause Analysis | Offshore Delivery Model & Process Transition | Workflow Streamlining & Automation | UAT and Data Migration | Stakeholder & Vendor Management | Team Leadership & Capability Building
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS & IMPACT SNAPSHOT
Volume Surge Management (Deutsche Bank): Directed a major spike in New Client Onboarding review volumes by instituting daily governance with QC and business teams; achieved 100% on-time completion with zero compliance breaches.
Offshore Transition (Deutsche Bank): Spearheaded the transition of KYC and New Client Onboarding operations from London to Bangalore for Global Markets UK, successfully establishing a scalable offshore delivery model that reduced costs and improved turnaround time.
Capacity Expansion (Deutsche Bank): Managed a surge in LDCM client onboarding beyond existing capacity by prioritizing pipelines, instituting daily governance calls, and ensuring compliance closure. Built a successful business case to expand headcount by 80% hiring and training new resources within 2 months, enabling seamless onboarding and full regulatory compliance.
UK Source of Wealth Reviews (JPMC): Streamlined end-to-end workflows with RAF/QC, enabling 100% completion of PEP reviews with UBO PEP’s Source of Wealth assessments with zero audit exceptions.
Governance & Audit Readiness (Deutsche Bank): Strengthened QC and escalation protocols, embedding robust documentation controls that delivered successful closure of all FCA regulatory queries without escalations.
LDCM Onboarding Transformation (Deutsche Bank): Enhanced onboarding for Leverage Debt Capital Markets, achieving 100% completion of priority tasks, boosting client satisfaction and ensuring regulatory compliance.
KYC Tool Global Rollout (Deutsche Bank): Directed UAT and global rollout of the DB CAR KYC tool, driving data migration, system testing, and deployment to improve onboarding efficiency and data accuracy.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & NOTEWORTHY MILESTONES
JP Morgan Chase, Bangalore						
Senior Associate –Quality Checks-New Client Onboarding, Remediation and PEP Reviews.	                  Oct 2021 – Present
Manage Quality Checks for New client onboarding, Periodic renewal and PEP reviews ensuring 100% adherence to global AML regulations via Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), sanctions/adverse news screening, and ongoing monitoring. 
Acting as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for KYC teams advising on complex risk assessments, mitigating potential regulatory breaches, and influencing senior stakeholders on risk appetite and policy interpretation.
Performed quality control testing and driving process improvements.
Partnered with RAF, KYC Maker, GFCC and Middle Office to deliver on-time onboarding and renewals for high-risk clients with UBOs/PEPs, safeguarding business continuity while meeting KYC and regulatory deadlines.
Collaborated with RAF teams on risk calibration and Source of Wealth reviews, enhancing documentation quality and ensuring audit-ready standards across all files.
Raising and escalating potential Quality assurance, process or policy issues.
Providing status reports and escalating issues to management, as appropriate.
Delivered structured training, coaching, and mentoring to uplift team capability, resulting in a measurable 10% improvement in QC scores and zero regulatory slippages during reviews.
Drove continuous process improvement through root-cause analysis and targeted remediation, resulting in faster turnaround times (TAT) and enhanced operational resilience.
Deutsche Bank, Bangalore									
Assistant Vice President – New Client Onboarding, KYC Remediation & Regulatory Audit	Feb 2014 – Jul 2019
Led end-to-end KYC process for New Client Onboarding for Corporate Finance and Global Transaction Banking across UK and Frankfurt booking locations, overseeing Maker, Checker and QA team in multi-location teams in Bangalore and Jaipur with a team size of 23 members. 
Led and motivated a team a team of Makers and Checkers in a challenging environment and assist the team in facilitating greater efficiency and timely production of high-quality KYC profiles.
Interfacing with Onshore team, Compliance, and Relationship Managers where applicable especially on matters that involve escalation of pending and ageing profiles.
Provided adequate training from a client due diligence perspective and developed a team of global KYC professionals.
Assisted the team in comprehending complex ownership structures. Thorough understanding of legal structures of various client types: financial institutions, corporate, NBFI, Trusts, Public/Government FIs, private companies, funds, SPV etc.
Experienced with AML / KYC tools such as SWIFT KYC Registry, Factiva, Bankers Almanac, etc.
Acted as a KYC SME to the team and resolve queries pertaining to high-risk KYC profiles.
Interpreted Regulatory/policy changes and communicate their implications to the team. Ability to establish action points arising out of the same and incorporate the impact within laid down procedures and keeping updated of developments within the financial regulatory environment and proactively educate the team on the same. 
Worked with the Quality Assurance team to ensure overall high-quality profiles emanating from the team and address quality issues to meet the established performance standards.
Provided timely and effective feedback on performance to the team on job objectives and mentor team members to achieve the expected performance standards.
Planned for effective utilization of resources and exhibit complete ownership of the business. 
Managing Six-Eye quality reviews for Low, Medium and high-risk client categories (Private entity, hedge funds, SPVs, Foundations, Regulated entities, Listed and PEPs), ensuring 100% compliance with global AML standards
Led Global KYC remediation programs across APAC and EMEA, ensuring timely compliance for Investment Banking clients under evolving FCA, MAS, and other regulatory frameworks.
Acted as regulatory SME for FCA and MAS audits, managing pre-audit testing, client file reviews, regulatory reporting, and post-audit remediation, closing gaps via targeted policy revisions and control enhancements.
Delivered Regulatory change management initiatives by performing gap analysis, impact assessments, and embedding changes through training, process re-engineering, and target operating model (TOM) redesign.
Oversaw UAT and Data migration for rollout of onboarding tool-DB CAR KYC, ensuring seamless onboarding. Support and coordinate the system testing and deployment of key initiatives to deliver on KYC & Client Due Diligence (CDD) change initiatives. 
Collaborated with AML Compliance on AML Audits to enhance due diligence and monitoring for high-risk clients (hedge funds, SPVs, PEPs), strengthening governance and risk mitigation.
Championed people leadership across distributed teams, driving recruitment, training, and performance management to sustain high-performing teams with consistently improved KPI delivery.
Team Manager – Client Onboarding & Transition Management					Feb 2010 – Jan 2014
Managed dual New Client Onboarding teams (Corporate Finance and GTB) across Bangalore and Jaipur, overseeing end-to-end KYC profiling, Enhanced due diligence (EDD), screening and compliance checks for new client relationships.
Acted as SME for client due diligence (CIP/KYC), partnering with Front Office, Compliance, and global onboarding teams to streamline processes and eliminate bottlenecks.
Executed Six-Eye quality reviews for high-risk client categories (hedge funds, SPVs, regulated entities, and PEPs), ensuring 100% compliance with global AML standards-BSA Patriot Act, OFAC and EU Anti Money Laundering Directives.
Designed and delivered structured training and onboarding programs, building team capability and reducing onboarding quality error rates.
Produced monthly MIS and KPI dashboards for senior management, enabling data-driven capacity planning, risk monitoring, and performance tracking.
Process Supervisor – Transition of New Client Onboarding					May 2007 – Feb 2010
Spearheaded the migration of KYC processes from London to Bangalore for Global Markets UK, laying the foundation for a scalable offshore model and scaling new team.
Conducted enhanced due diligence for PEPs and clients from high-risk countries, escalating derogatory findings to AML Compliance for decisioning.
Performed 4-eye quality checks and provided recommendations on account acceptance/rejection for entities including hedge funds, Trusts, Private Entities, SPVs, and regulated institutions.
Supported the MiFID remediation program, ensuring adherence to EU client classification and suitability regulations.
